assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: All site boundary, key area, and derived design layers are based on repository provisional polygons (official_boundary=false, boundary_precision=provisional_rough), not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All area/length/coverage values are concept references only; when official polygons are published the entire geometry, metrics, figures, HTML and PDF package must be recalculated as a whole.

assumptions.statement: Existing building age, structure, ownership, vacancy, heritage elements and land-use survey data are not yet available.
assumptions.impact: Building groups, retain/renovate/demolish classifications and any density/height statements remain conceptual; no parcel-level conclusion is made.

assumptions.statement: Unified pedestrian, cycling, public-transport flows, station integration conditions, parking and non-motorized network data are not yet available.
assumptions.impact: Mobility network lengths are concept-scale only; coverage, accessibility and station designs remain pending verification.

assumptions.statement: Municipal utility capacity, pipelines, drainage, fire protection and energy infrastructure conditions are not available.
assumptions.impact: No pipeline, road redline, capacity or engineering conclusion is made; infrastructure strategies are frameworks for professional deepening.

assumptions.statement: Current public-space baseline and comparable coverage data are not available.
assumptions.impact: Conceptual public_space_ratio (1.63%) has no baseline comparison and cannot be used as a priority claim before verification.

assumptions.statement: CS01-CS08 global case official URLs were retrieved on 2026-08-15, but first-hand mechanism descriptions, quantitative effects and current operating status remain pending professional review.
assumptions.impact: Cases are used only as concept clues and do not enter formal comparative scoring; 16 pending verification items are registered in visual/assets/data/case-source-ledger.json.

assumptions.statement: GOV-OBS-01/02/03, OPS-WIN-01/02 and INCLUSION-SERVICE-01 now have complete measurement protocols (instrument, frequency, roles, fields, baseline, gates) in visual/assets/data/measurement-protocol.json.
assumptions.impact: Metric values remain unknown/null until real pilot baselines exist; no target values are fabricated.

assumptions.statement: The competitive map was refreshed on 2026-08-16 as COMP-20260816-507 (visual/assets/data/competitive-map-20260816.json). A same-origin PASSING LOOP proposal and several protocol peers are now present, so the proposal no longer claims "no same-structure concept".
assumptions.impact: Differentiation now rests on verifiable protocol artifacts, spatial ID binding, measurement protocols and the S03 first-100-days contract; the snapshot remains a working judgement, not a permanent fact.

assumptions.statement: References to '设计方向 / 设计契约' in the proposal correspond to the archived contract document shipped in the package.
assumptions.impact: Reviewers can verify referenced section numbers offline at visual/assets/data/design-direction-archive.json.

assumptions.statement: proposal.en.md is a faithful condensed companion; the Chinese proposal.md is authoritative. English display counterparts for figures, PDFs and HTML are not yet generated.
assumptions.impact: Deterministic self-check reports legacy bilingual warnings; these are non-blocking but should be closed in a later bilingual pass.

assumptions.statement: The S03 first-100-days delivery contract (MY-100D-S03-001) is a conceptual delivery contract, not an approved schedule, permit or commitment.
assumptions.impact: All gate dates, actors, site cards and permissions remain pending professional confirmation; the contract explicitly expires into a public no-go archive unless its gates are met.

assumptions.statement: The cultural timeline in visual/assets/data/cultural-narrative-ledger.json keeps historical common-knowledge items (1905-1909 construction, 1909 switchback, 1910 Qinghuayuan station) as unverified until authoritative cleared sources are registered; repository-seed policy URLs are registered but their content has not been fetched and verified.
assumptions.impact: The narrative may use the engineering-method translation but must not assert unverified historical facts in the main title, logo, core signage or formal heritage conclusions; first-hand heritage and conservation data remain a known weakness.
